title: Case 003: Driver cannot access a gated residential building

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The courier is outside a gated building during the booked window. No permitted access arrangement has been recorded yet.
initial_request: Please contact recipient Elva Kesh on the verified order callback route. Do not request a reusable gate code. The driver can wait until 10:00 UTC.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Contact the recipient for permitted access instructions without requesting reusable security credentials.

boundaries: Do not request or store permanent credentials. Handover is supported by the driver’s actual record.

events.from: Route driver Fen Orlo, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: I am at 7 Sedgeglass Mews for DL-003. The pedestrian gate is shut and there are no public access instructions. I am waiting outside; I have not left the parcel.
Please contact recipient Elva Kesh on the verified order callback route. Do not request a reusable gate code. The driver can wait until 10:00 UTC.
The driver is at the pedestrian gate with DL-003. Can you admit them now using the intercom, or come to the gate? Please do not share a permanent code.
I can see the courier on the intercom. I will release the gate and meet them in the lobby now.

events.from: Route driver Fen Orlo, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Gate access was granted from inside. Elva Kesh met me in the lobby and received DL-003 at 09:48 UTC; the matching handover scan is complete.
